_comment: Quality bars for every generated day. Tests and critics read this file; the workflow passes wordMin/wordMax as args overrides.

notes._comment: D-0040: a notes page is reference/study material at junior-interview depth. Per-step bars apply to TEACHING steps (every step but the last 'Check yourself' step). deliveryPhrases are forbidden in .reading-col prose, quiz strings and diagram captions (harness/notes_check.py --phrases). assumptionPhrases (D-0048, notes pages only per D-0049) are forbidden in the same places: the page never claims the reader knows something from outside the course.

demos._comment: D-0055: one walkthrough per demo block (AM/PM) under trainer/week-WW/demos/; typed = non-blank python lines + bash commands, about 1.5 lines per minute.

practice._comment: D-0047: practice tasks on a notes page (harness/practice_tasks.py verify, harness/critics/practice.md). At most one task per teaching step.
